meta.note: No Newari phrase is invented. Exercises marked planned_type are playable fallbacks; upgrade once a native speaker verifies phrases.

rules.stats: stats = base_stats + sum(stat_gains of lessons completed for the first time); never stored randomly; replays add nothing
rules.xp: xp_earned = sum(xp of exercises answered correctly on the first and only try); a wrong answer forfeits that exercise's xp and skips to the next exercise
rules.level_curve: xp needed to go from level n to n+1 = 100 + 25*(n-1)
